messages:
maya: Quick assistive-flow pass on the new Alerts drawer — putting notes here so we can triage. sam: thanks! can you list concrete failures you saw? I can file fixes. maya: TL;DR: keyboard trap when opening the drawer, low contrast on 'snooze' secondary text, and screenreader announcement order is odd (counts announced after items). vijay: oof. repro steps for the trap? maya: Open drawer with `d` shortcut or hamburger > Alerts. Tab once to focus the first alert, then shift+tab goes to page behind drawer instead of back to last focusable in drawer — looks like focus isn’t constrained. olivia: prob with missing focus-trap container or tabindex="-1" on backdrop? @sam can you check the modal wrapper? sam: looking. I see we render drawer as sibling to main content (not portal). backdrop has `pointer-events` but no inert/focus trap. quick patch: add a focus-trap div and set `inert` on main content when drawer open. maya: also contrast: the inline timestamp and 'snooze' label are at 3.8:1 on avg on our monitor. needs >= 4.5:1 for normal text. Suggest bumping color or increase weight. vijay: can we do a quick CSS tweak to .alert-meta { color: var(--text-subtle-strong); font-weight: 500; } then run color audit? maya: yes — or use AAA token for small text. Also screenreader bits: NVDA reads the items first, then a live region announces "3 new alerts" which feels jarring. The count should be part of an aria-labelledby on the list container so ordering is logical. olivia: good call. propose markup: maya: ```html

    Alerts (3)

  • ...
``` sam: small note — don't put `aria-live` on the whole list if VO will re-announce all items; better to update a concise status element with `aria-live` and keep it visually hidden. maya: yup — status element approach is less noisy. Example: ```html
3 new alerts

    Alerts

  • ...
``` vijay: makes sense. olivia: test matrix proposal: VoiceOver (mac+ios), NVDA (Win), TalkBack (android) + keyboard only. I can run VoiceOver next. a11y-ci: CI note — added axe baseline check for alert drawer contrast and focusability. Will fail the pipeline if trap not fixed. sam: I'll open a small PR covering: focus trap + inert main + aria status element + contrast token update. ETA end of day. maya: awesome — after PR please add test steps in the PR description and tag me for a quick re-check. sam: will do :thumbsup: olivia: thanks everyone — this should improve assistive flow and visual handoff.
